headline: PINBALL now has a row of cabinets — CABINET TWO "EMBER RIDER" joins the arcade
lede: The pinball machine row is real: two lit mini-cabinets on the attract screen, arrows or tap to pick, and a second table that is a true mirror build of the engine with its own hotter economy and ember skin. The session also turned up an unproven proof — the harness claimed mutants it could not plant — and fixed that honestly.

notes.text: #3232 shipped via PR #3239: row-of-cabinets attract (arrows/tap select, SPACE starts, quick-retry persists the cabinet), EMBER RIDER — an x-mirror build with left launch, hotter rules (spinner 15, MULT x2-x4, MULTIBALL 1200, 4 s save, faster tilt) and oxblood/gold/teal palette. pinballcheck 139/139, pinballplay 26/26 live Chrome.

A checkpoint claimed "wirefeed mutant caught" — pinballcheck had zero plant support. Rule 8 in action: read the result before writing another probe. Added 4 anchored mutants (seed/economy/mirror/search), all caught, plus new ball-search pins and seed-is-load-bearing pins: stateHash embeds gs.seed, so hash divergence alone was toothless — the fix compares raw physics lines under a scripted nudge stream.
Corpses pay: a warden target already held elsewhere becomes a resume, not a rebuild — the slot-a branch was 6 commits deep, needed only a rebase, a re-proof and the missing mutant loop.
QA tail #3237 got fresh handoff notes (driven attract demo, single-ball music bed, rig pixel-window hardening).
